findings.message: [BR-KSA-19]-Each Document level charge (BG-21) shall have a code for the reason for document level charge (BT-105).

[BR-KSA-63]-If the buyer country code (BT-55) is "SA", then these fields are mandatory:street name (BT-50), building number (KSA-18), postal code (BT-53), city (BT-52), District (KSA-4), country code (BT-55).For more information please access this link:https://splonline.com.sa/en/national-address-1/
[BR-KSA-69]-A VAT breakdown (BG-23) with VAT Category code (BT-118) 'Zero rated' shall have a VAT exception reason code (BT-121).
[BR-KSA-15]-The tax invoice ((invoice type code (BT-30) = 388) and (invoice transaction code (KSA-2) has "01" as first 2 digits)) must contain the supply date (KSA-5).
[BR-KSA-F-06-C28] - Field character limits for the Buyer Address - District field (KSA-4) have not been met. The minimum limit is 1 character and the maximum limit is 127 characters.
